node.title: Re: GetOpt::Std change of recommended subroutine
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [hippo],

TL;DR: It was supposed to be "Use of getopt() is not recommended" all along.

  1. The discussion in [rt://116098|RT#116098] resulted in getopt being not recommended, resulting in commit [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commitdiff/0c0a84c65e572a92388387363562ff4da91a9380|0c0a84c] (first in v5.19.0, part of v5.20.0), the wording was "The getopt() function is similar ... Its use is not recommended."
  2. [rt://41359|RT#41359] doesn't deal with the getopt vs getopts issue, instead it's a different [doc://Getopt::Std] documentation issue, the resulting patch [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commitdiff/243ac78f8a172f346f09976891c458840877393b|243ac78] (first in v5.19.3, part of v5.20.0) rewords the relevant paragraphs, but unfortunately contained a typo which said "Use of getopts() is not recommended" instead of "Use of getopt() is not recommended"
  3. I [https://rt.perl.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=41359#txn-1307592|reported] that typo and it was fixed in [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commitdiff/624c6f90349a08e2f333e22f977f52eb37cc6419|624c6f9] (first in v5.21.4, part of v5.22.0). Unfortunately it does not seem to have made it into [doc://perl5220delta]. Update: Although backporting the fix into the v5.20.x series was mentioned, it seems that didn't happen.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
